title: video review verdict
description: The video reviewer's scores for one draft. video-build.mjs passes a draft only when every score is 4 or 5.

reason.description: One or two sentences naming what you saw.

value.description: The skill's value is clear within the first seconds of the result.

readable.description: Every word reads at tile size; one idea at a time.

looks.description: Attractive, calm, on-brand, nothing broken or cramped.

honest.description: Shows the real result, typical not cherry-picked, nothing invented.

fixes.description: The most important concrete changes, most important first. Empty when nothing needs fixing.

cover_at.description: The time in seconds (3.2 to 8.9) of the frame that makes the best cover.

summary.description: One sentence on the draft as a whole.
